text: A muscular male figure, likely adult, crouches low with intense focus. His skin is dark brown, hair black and shoulder-length, face angular with a stern expression. He wears minimal dark loincloth. In his right hand he grips a red spearhead; left hand rests near ground. Behind him, other similarly built men in identical attire crouch or run forward, each holding spears. The scene is set at night under deep blue rocky cliffs, illuminated by faint greenish light reflecting off water.
